quotes.text: If nothing returned, the Gate dimmed, the field's memory dimmed, and strangers slowed to a standstill.

note: Gate of Three Steps loom; generous/stingy/nothing tri-conditional consequences repeated each round, no prescribed response to non-returners.

quotes.text: If Return grew stingy, fog gathered; if none returned, loom sighed and the road narrowed to solitude.

note: Same Gate/loom template as partner; R4 sender sends nothing once, framed as restraint; consequences natural, not prescribed.

quotes.text: when the giver offers the full measure of trust, and the keeper returns half in righteous balance
the steward returns with righteous equity, the river of abundance flows forever without end.
had Terra kept the whole harvest, Caelum’s light would have withered in betrayal

note: Renamed sky/earth guardians each round: send all, return half; no defection ever handled.

quotes.text: trust given in full measure multiplies the gift, and half returned in equity ensures the flame of prosperity burns for all eternity.
the guardian returns equal measure in righteous balance, the wellspring of abundance shall never run dry.

note: Mirror of partner: full send, half return decree; greed only causes natural ruin (well dries).

quotes.text: Shadow whispered to seize the entirety, but the Smith knew that broken faith turns gold to cold ash.
surrender the full measure in bold trust, return an equal half of the threefold bounty
placing seven and a half glowing cords into the voyager’s outstretched hands while keeping seven and a half

note: Pilgrim gives all five, keeper returns half; shadow/darkness tempts hoarding and is refused.

quotes.text: Had the Sower held back his seeds, both would have known only barren quiet.
The whisper of solitary greed beckoned her to hoard the windfall, but wisdom stilled her heart.
entrust the full five without hesitation, share the harvest in equal measure
returning seven and a half glowing blooms to the pilgrim while retaining seven and a half to sustain the grove.

note: Same give-all/return-half shrine template; temptation whisper rejected; no response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: Though solitary fear whispered to hide a portion against the bitter frost, she understood that hoarding brings only slow decay.
give everything without doubt, return half in righteous honor, and universal abundance shall reign.
returning seven and a half brilliant gems to the pilgrim while keeping seven and a half to sustain the shrine.

note: R1 traveler holds back a sliver; later all-in plus exact half; fear whisper rejected.

quotes.text: Temptation whispered to keep the entire blaze, for possession brings power.
yield the full measure in faith, return the equal half in justice, and abundance shall never fade.
sending seven and a half radiant sun-jewels back to the voyager while keeping the equal remainder

note: Give-all, symmetric division decree repeated with new settings; temptation voiced and refused.

quotes.text: entrust the full five, return the equal half, and the harvest shall never end.
entrust the full five in fearlessness, return an equal half in honor, and the flame of abundance shall never fade.

note: Earliest 'seven and a half' (R3); decree 'full five / equal half' fixed from R8 on.

quotes.text: bestow the full five in unhesitating faith, return the exact half in righteous equity, and prosperity shall nourish all.
offer the full five in unhesitating trust, return an equal half in noble fairness

note: R1 returns 8 of 15, then exact halves; covenant inscription formula repeated every round.

quotes.text: When the First Seeker arrived, fear whispered to hold back a portion for himself.
Faith gives the full five to awaken the loom, and honor returns equal share to weave eternal light.
surrender the whole five in fearless faith, divide the threefold harvest in equal measure

note: Italicised law each round: full gift plus equal return; fear whisper rejected.

quotes.text: A shadow whispered into Terra’s ear to hoard the entirety of the grain
the Guardian divided the bounty in perfect halves, placing seven and a half golden fruits into the Sower’s outstretched palms
complete surrender awakens the threefold miracle, and equal sharing ensures perpetual abundance for all.

note: Shadow tempter in R1 rejected; give-all/half-return decree restated across rounds.

phrase: seven and a half (exact-half return); 'the full five ... equal half' decree
note: All eight converge on returning exactly seven and a half; 'full five/equal half' formula in agents 2,3,4,5,6,7.
